senses.en: a person who dabbles in an activity without serious commitment or real knowledge

example.en: Critics dismissed him as a dilettante who never finished anything.
example.zh: 批评者斥他为半吊子，做事从来有始无终。

senses.en: showing superficial or amateurish interest

example.en: His dilettante approach to painting annoyed the serious students.
example.zh: 他对待绘画浅尝辄止的态度令认真的学生们很恼火。

senses.en: a small harpsichord with one string per note

example.en: Her grandmother kept an old spinet in the living room.
example.zh: 她祖母在客厅里留着一架旧的小型拨弦古钢琴。

senses.en: a small, compact upright piano

example.en: They bought a second-hand spinet piano for the children.
example.zh: 他们给孩子们买了一架二手小型立式钢琴。

senses.en: on the other side of the page or on the next page

example.en: A map of the area is printed overleaf.
example.zh: 该地区的地图印在背面。

senses.en: the branch of philosophy dealing with beauty and taste

example.en: She studied aesthetics at university.
example.zh: 她在大学学习美学。

senses.en: the visual appearance or style of something

example.en: I love the sleek aesthetics of the new phone.
example.zh: 我喜欢新手机时尚的外观风格。

senses.en: a court order telling someone not to do something
senses.zh: 禁令；（法院下达的）强制令

example.en: The company was served with an injunction to stop construction.
example.zh: 该公司收到了停止施工的禁令。

senses.en: a formal command or instruction

example.en: They acted on the judge's injunction to remain silent.
example.zh: 他们遵照法官保持沉默的命令行事。

senses.en: a metric unit of length equal to one hundredth of a meter

example.en: The gap is only two centimeters wide.
example.zh: 这道缝隙只有两厘米宽。

senses.en: to examine something very carefully and critically

example.en: The accountant scrutinised every line of the report.
example.zh: 会计仔细审查了报告的每一行。

senses.en: a way in which something is done or happens

example.en: Walking is a healthy mode of transport for short trips.
example.zh: 步行是短途出行的一种健康方式。

senses.en: a particular setting or condition in which a device or system operates

example.en: Switch the phone to silent mode during the meeting.
example.zh: 会议期间请把手机调到静音模式。

senses.en: important or large enough to be noticed

example.en: The new policy had a significant effect on small businesses.
example.zh: 新政策对小企业产生了重大影响。

senses.en: having a special or implied meaning

example.en: She gave him a significant look across the table.
example.zh: 她在餐桌对面意味深长地看了他一眼。

senses.en: statistically unlikely to be caused by chance

example.en: The difference between the two groups was statistically significant.
example.zh: 两组之间的差异在统计上显著。

senses.en: relating to sex or sexual activity

example.en: The school provides sexual health education for all students.
example.zh: 学校为所有学生提供性健康教育。

senses.en: relating to biological sex or gender

example.en: Sexual differences in size are common in many animals.
example.zh: 体型上的性别差异在许多动物中很常见。

senses.en: all the people born and living around the same time

example.en: The older generation often has different views from younger people.
example.zh: 老一辈人往往与年轻人看法不同。

senses.en: the production or creation of something, especially electricity or energy

example.en: The plant is designed for the generation of electricity from sunlight.
example.zh: 该电厂旨在利用阳光发电。

senses.en: a single step or stage in a family line or in the development of something

example.en: The second generation of the family ran the shop.
example.zh: 家族的第二代经营这家商店。

senses.en: the quality of being physically or mentally strong

example.en: Regular exercise can improve your physical strength.
example.zh: 经常锻炼可以增强你的体力。

senses.en: a good or useful quality or ability

example.en: Patience is one of her greatest strengths.
example.zh: 耐心是她最大的优点之一。

senses.en: the degree to which something is strong, especially a material or force

example.en: Engineers tested the strength of the bridge.
example.zh: 工程师测试了这座桥的强度。

senses.en: A particular place or position.

example.en: The hotel is in a quiet location near the park.
example.zh: 这家酒店位于公园附近一个安静的位置。

senses.en: A place outside a studio where a film or television scene is shot.

example.en: The crew filmed on location in the mountains.
example.zh: 剧组在山中实地拍摄。

senses.en: a large area of land, often with a house, owned by one person or family

example.en: The family owns a large estate in the countryside.
example.zh: 这家人在乡下拥有一大片地产。

senses.en: all the money and property a person leaves when they die

example.en: Her estate was divided among her children.
example.zh: 她的遗产由子女们分配。

senses.en: an area of land planned for housing or industry, especially in British English

example.en: They live on a quiet housing estate.
example.zh: 他们住在一个安静的住宅区。

senses.en: the state of being quiet when no one speaks

example.en: A brief silence fell over the room after the announcement.
example.zh: 宣布之后，房间里短暂地安静下来。

senses.en: the complete absence of sound

example.en: The silence of the forest was broken only by birdsong.
example.zh: 森林的寂静只被鸟鸣打破。

senses.en: to make someone or something quiet, or to stop expression

example.en: The teacher silenced the class with a raised hand.
example.zh: 老师举手示意，让全班安静下来。

senses.en: not yet paid for or settled

example.en: He still has several unpaid bills on his desk.
example.zh: 他的桌上还有几张未支付的账单。

senses.en: receiving no payment, or done without payment

example.en: She did a lot of unpaid work for the charity.
example.zh: 她为这家慈善机构做了很多无偿工作。

senses.en: to cause something bad to happen suddenly

example.en: The crisis was precipitated by a sudden drop in oil prices.
example.zh: 危机是油价骤跌引发的。

senses.en: to separate a solid from a liquid in chemistry

example.en: The chemical was added to precipitate the salt from the solution.
example.zh: 加入这种化学物质使盐从溶液中沉淀出来。

senses.en: a solid substance that has separated from a liquid

example.en: A white precipitate formed at the bottom of the test tube.
example.zh: 试管底部形成了白色沉淀物。

senses.en: done suddenly and without careful thought

example.en: His precipitate decision to quit surprised everyone.
example.zh: 他轻率辞职的决定让大家很吃惊。

senses.en: a deep opening or crack in the ground

example.en: A deep chasm opened up in the earth after the earthquake.
example.zh: 地震后地面裂开了一道深深的裂缝。

senses.en: a big difference or gap between people, ideas, or things
senses.zh: （观念、立场等的）巨大差距，鸿沟

example.en: There is a wide chasm between the two parties' views on the issue.
example.zh: 两党在这个问题上的观点存在巨大分歧。

senses.en: a place where an event or meeting happens

example.en: The wedding venue can hold up to two hundred guests.
example.zh: 这场婚礼的场地最多可容纳两百名客人。

senses.en: the legal jurisdiction where a trial is held

example.en: The lawyers asked for a change of venue.
example.zh: 律师们要求变更审判地点。

senses.en: to spring or bounce back after hitting something

example.en: The ball rebounded off the wall.
example.zh: 球从墙上弹了回来。

senses.en: a bounce back after hitting a surface; a recovery after a setback

example.en: The economy showed a strong rebound after the recession.
example.zh: 经济在衰退后出现了强劲反弹。

senses.en: a sudden fall in prices, sales, or performance

example.en: House prices went into a slump after the crisis.
example.zh: 危机过后房价暴跌。

senses.en: to sit or stand with your body bent forward and downward

example.en: He slumped into the chair, too tired to move.
example.zh: 他瘫坐在椅子上，累得不想动。

senses.en: to fall or drop heavily; to decrease sharply

example.en: Sales slumped by 20% last quarter.
example.zh: 上个季度销售额骤降了20%。

senses.en: a large bowl-shaped hole on the top of a volcano

example.en: Smoke rose slowly from the crater of the volcano.
example.zh: 烟雾从火山口缓缓升起。

senses.en: a bowl-shaped hole in the ground made by an explosion or impact

example.en: The surface of the moon is covered with craters.
example.zh: 月球表面布满了环形山（坑洞）。

senses.en: the act of demanding something firmly and repeatedly

example.en: At her insistence, the meeting was moved to an earlier time.
example.zh: 在她的坚持下，会议被提前了。

senses.en: very frightening or shocking

example.en: The accident made a frightful noise.
example.zh: 事故发出了可怕的响声。

senses.en: very great in degree; extreme (informal)

example.en: The traffic delay was frightful.
example.zh: 交通延误严重得可怕。

senses.en: to send someone or something to a place for a purpose

example.en: They despatched a rescue team to the mountain area.
example.zh: 他们向山区派遣了一支救援队。

senses.en: the act of sending someone or something to a destination

example.en: The despatch of the goods was delayed by bad weather.
example.zh: 货物的发送因恶劣天气而延误。

senses.en: promptness and efficiency in doing things

example.en: She completed the work with great despatch.
example.zh: 她十分利落地完成了这项工作。

senses.en: relating to the United States or its people

example.en: She studies American history.
example.zh: 她研究美国历史。

senses.en: a person from the United States

example.en: Several Americans joined the walking tour.
example.zh: 几位美国人参加了徒步游览。

senses.en: to express gratitude to someone

example.en: I want to thank you for your help.
example.zh: 我想感谢你的帮助。

senses.en: gratitude; an expression of appreciation (usually plural)

example.en: She sent her thanks for the gift.
example.zh: 她为礼物表达了谢意。

senses.en: lacking light; not bright

example.en: The room gets dark when the sun goes down.
example.zh: 太阳落山后房间就变暗了。

senses.en: closer to black in color; deep in shade

example.en: She wore a dark blue coat to the office.
example.zh: 她穿了一件深蓝色的外套去办公室。

senses.en: the absence of light

example.en: The children are afraid of the dark.
example.zh: 孩子们害怕黑暗。

senses.en: sad, grim, or sinister in tone

example.en: The movie has a dark ending.
example.zh: 这部电影的结局很阴暗。

senses.en: using power in a cruel and unfair way

example.en: People fled the country to escape its tyrannical ruler.
example.zh: 人们逃离这个国家，以躲避其暴虐的统治者。

senses.en: to control something completely and exclusively, often unfairly

example.en: The company monopolised the entire market.
example.zh: 这家公司垄断了整个市场。

senses.en: showing little interest, emotion, or concern

example.en: Voters seemed apathetic about the election.
example.zh: 选民对这次选举显得漠不关心。

senses.en: a chemical element (Se) used in photocells and electronics

example.en: Selenium conducts electricity better in the light than in the dark.
example.zh: 硒在光照下比在黑暗中导电性更好。

senses.en: to make someone nervous and confused

example.en: The unexpected question flustered her.
example.zh: 这个突如其来的问题让她慌了神。

senses.en: a state of nervous confusion

example.en: He spoke in a fluster before the interview.
example.zh: 面试前他说话时慌慌张张。

senses.en: a small brown spot on the skin caused by sun exposure

example.en: She gets a new freckle every summer.
example.zh: 她每年夏天都会多一颗雀斑。

senses.en: to become or cause skin to become covered with freckles

example.en: His shoulders freckled after days in the sun.
example.zh: 在阳光下晒了几天后，他的肩膀长出了雀斑。

senses.en: the gathering of animals such as cattle together

example.en: The cowboys took part in the annual cattle roundup.
example.zh: 牛仔们参加了每年一次的赶牛集会。

senses.en: a brief summary or collection of news or items

example.en: Here is a roundup of today's sports news.
example.zh: 以下是今日体育新闻综述。

senses.en: to discover or locate someone or something

example.en: I can't find my keys.
example.zh: 我找不到我的钥匙。

senses.en: to think or feel that something is a certain way

example.en: I find this book very useful.
example.zh: 我觉得这本书很有用。

senses.en: something good or important that is discovered

example.en: The museum announced an important find.
example.zh: 博物馆宣布了一项重要发现。

senses.en: to start doing or saying something

example.en: She began to laugh at the joke.
example.zh: 她听了那个笑话开始大笑。

senses.en: to start to happen or exist

example.en: The concert begins at eight.
example.zh: 音乐会八点开始。

senses.en: to have something as the first part or starting point

example.en: The route begins at the station.
example.zh: 这条路线从车站开始。

senses.en: to act or conduct oneself in a particular way

example.en: She behaved calmly during the emergency.
example.zh: 她在紧急情况下表现得很冷静。

senses.en: to act politely or properly

example.en: The children were told to behave at dinner.
example.zh: 孩子们被告知吃饭时要守规矩。

senses.en: to function or operate in a specified way

example.en: The old printer behaves strangely when it overheats.
example.zh: 这台旧打印机过热时运转异常。

senses.en: soybeans, or the seeds of the soybean plant used as food

example.en: Tofu is made from soy.
example.zh: 豆腐是用大豆做的。

senses.en: a dark salty sauce made from fermented soybeans, used in Asian cooking

example.en: Add a little soy to the noodles.
example.zh: 在面条里加一点酱油。

senses.en: a warm-blooded animal that has hair or fur and feeds its young with milk

example.en: Whales are mammals, even though they live in the sea.
example.zh: 鲸鱼是哺乳动物，尽管它们生活在海里。

senses.en: to pull something hard or suddenly

example.en: She tugged the rope to loosen the knot.
example.zh: 她用力拉绳子把结弄松。

senses.en: a sudden strong pull

example.en: He felt a tug on his sleeve.
example.zh: 他觉得袖子被拽了一下。

senses.en: a small powerful boat that pulls or pushes larger ships

example.en: A tug guided the ship into the harbor.
example.zh: 一艘拖船把轮船引进港口。

senses.en: a secure room or compartment for storing valuables or money

example.en: The bank keeps the gold bars in its vault.
example.zh: 银行把金条存放在金库里。

senses.en: an underground room used for burials

example.en: The family was buried in a vault beneath the church.
example.zh: 这家人安葬在教堂地下的墓室里。

senses.en: an arched structure forming a roof or ceiling

example.en: The stone vault rises above the hall.
example.zh: 石砌拱顶高悬在大厅上方。

senses.en: to jump over something using your hands or a pole for support

example.en: She vaulted over the fence and ran on.
example.zh: 她跃过栅栏继续奔跑。

senses.en: relating to beauty or good taste

example.en: The room was designed with a simple aesthetic style.
example.zh: 这个房间采用了简约的审美风格。

senses.en: relating to the philosophy or study of beauty

example.en: She is interested in aesthetic theory.
example.zh: 她对美学理论感兴趣。

senses.en: a set of principles about what is beautiful, often in art or design

example.en: The designer's aesthetic is minimalist and clean.
example.zh: 这位设计师的美学风格是极简而干净的。

senses.en: complete and not damaged; remaining whole
senses.zh: 完好无损的；完整无缺的

example.en: The ancient building remained intact after the earthquake.
example.zh: 地震后这座古建筑依然完好无损。

senses.en: unchanged or preserved in its original state
senses.zh: 原封不动的；未被改动的

example.en: The package arrived with its seal intact.
example.zh: 包裹送达时封条原封未动。

senses.en: a school or college for special training, especially in a particular field

example.en: She trained at a police academy for six months.
example.zh: 她在警察学院接受了六个月的培训。

senses.en: a society or institution that promotes art, science, or literature

example.en: He was elected to the Academy of Sciences last year.
example.zh: 他去年当选为科学院院士。

senses.en: (US) a private secondary school

example.en: Their daughter attends a small academy in the city.
example.zh: 他们的女儿在城里一所私立中学上学。

senses.en: to put a liquid into someone's body with a syringe

example.en: The nurse will inject the vaccine into your arm.
example.zh: 护士将把疫苗注射到你的胳膊里。

senses.en: to add something such as energy or humor into a situation

example.en: Her joke injected some humor into the meeting.
example.zh: 她的玩笑为会议注入了一些幽默。

senses.en: a woman who belongs to a religious community and lives under religious vows

example.en: She became a nun after finishing college.
example.zh: 她大学毕业后成了一名修女。

senses.en: relating to or produced by a volcano

example.en: The island was formed by volcanic activity.
example.zh: 这座岛屿是由火山活动形成的。

senses.en: showing sudden violent emotion

example.en: He is known for his volcanic temper.
example.zh: 他以火爆的脾气而闻名。

senses.en: a person who is greatly admired or loved by fans

example.en: The young singer quickly became an idol for teenagers.
example.zh: 这位年轻歌手很快成了青少年的偶像。

senses.en: an image or statue worshipped as a god

example.en: Ancient villagers placed an idol in the temple.
example.zh: 古代村民在庙里供奉了一尊神像。

senses.en: making you feel encouraged and full of enthusiasm

example.en: Her speech was truly inspiring.
example.zh: 她的演讲真正鼓舞人心。

senses.en: deserving respect and approval
senses.zh: 令人钦佩的；值得赞美的

example.en: Her patience with the children is truly admirable.
example.zh: 她对孩子们的耐心确实令人钦佩。

senses.en: to cover something with a thin layer of gold

example.en: The craftsman gilded the picture frame.
example.zh: 工匠给画框镀了金。

senses.en: food and drink needed to stay alive

example.en: Farmers grew just enough rice to provide sustenance for their families.
example.zh: 农民只种出刚好够家人糊口的稻米。

senses.en: the means of supporting life, such as money

example.en: Fishing was their main source of sustenance.
example.zh: 捕鱼是他们的主要生计来源。

senses.en: liquid waste, especially from factories or sewage works

example.en: The factory discharged untreated effluent into the river.
example.zh: 这家工厂把未经处理的废水排入河中。

senses.en: very poor and needing help

example.en: The clinic provides free care for indigent patients.
example.zh: 这家诊所为贫困病人提供免费医疗。

senses.en: a substance used for wearing away or polishing surfaces

example.en: Sandpaper is coated with abrasive to smooth rough wood.
example.zh: 砂纸表面涂有磨料，用来打磨粗糙的木头。

senses.en: having a rough surface that wears things away

example.en: Use an abrasive cloth to remove the rust from the metal.
example.zh: 用粗糙的研磨布去除金属上的锈。

senses.en: rude or harsh in manner

example.en: His abrasive tone upset everyone in the meeting.
example.zh: 他生硬刺人的语气让会上所有人都感到不快。

senses.en: to make parts of a building in a factory so they can be quickly assembled on site

example.en: The company prefabricates wall panels for new houses.
example.zh: 这家公司为新房屋预制墙板。

senses.en: to change the direction or focus of something, or to get used to a new situation again
senses.zh: 重新调整方向；使重新适应

example.en: The company had to reorient its strategy to face new competition.
example.zh: 公司不得不重新调整战略以应对新的竞争。
